name: data-pipeline
description: Data pipeline monorepo: apps/api (collection service), workers/cleaner (LLM cleaning), packages/shared (contracts), skills/ (pipe-push variants).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @data-pipeline/shared && npm run build -w @data-pipeline/api && npm run build -w @data-pipeline/cleaner && npm run build -w @data-pipeline/web
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
